name: command-menu-02
title: Command Menu with Keyboard Shortcuts
description: A command menu with keyboard shortcuts block.

standards.purpose: Let a keyboard-first user jump anywhere with a few keystrokes.
useWhen: The product has many destinations or actions and a keyboard-heavy audience.
doNotUseWhen: The surface has fewer than a handful of destinations.

rules.check: The palette opens from a documented shortcut and from a visible trigger.
Escape closes the palette and returns focus to the invoking control.
Results are grouped under labels, and an empty query state is shown when nothing matches.
The dialog exposes a combobox/listbox relationship with an accessible name.
